specs.title: Public booking flow
specs.why: This is the revenue path: without it the product has no customer-facing function.
specs.scope: Multi-step booking on `/{slug}/book`: pick service, pick date, pick slot, enter client details (name, phone), confirm. Creates `Booking(status=pending_payment)` and holds the slot for 10 minutes.
tasks: E2E test that books a slot end to end
acceptance: A held slot is blocked from other sessions

specs.title: Booking confirmation page and notification stub
specs.why: Customers need proof of booking, and the domain event is the seam that later notification work plugs into.
specs.scope: After booking, show a confirmation screen with an `.ics` download and signed reschedule/cancel links. Emit a stub notification event.
tasks: Signed tokens with 30-day expiry for reschedule and cancel
acceptance: The `.ics` file imports into Google Calendar cleanly
The event is emitted and logged
